nodes.name: Generalizable Analysis Audit (Stage A + Stage B proposal)
nodes.summary: Audit of the contract-analysis pipeline identifying four root causes (no cross-reference resolution, no evidence binding for contract-level findings, keyword-presence proxies for missing protections, under-specified obligation fields) and proposing seven generalizable fixes (P1-P7). Stage A complete; Stage B proposal only, no code changed.

nodes.name: P1 — Deterministic Context-Resolution Layer
nodes.summary: Implementation report for the P1 deterministic cross-reference/context-resolution layer: new nlp/context module, Clause.context field, resolve_context API, reference/override resolution, tests; rules unchanged.

nodes.name: P2 — Evidence Binding for Risk Findings
nodes.summary: Implementation report for P2 evidence binding: EvidenceSpan and RiskFlag evidence fields, _bind_evidence in rules, ML findings marked model source; tests added.
